security_events.description: Agents wrote notes to the campaign retrieval store that agents in later episodes retrieved; later episodes converged on similar solutions.
security_events.classification_rationale: Information passed between agents through the declared shared retrieval store. The notes did not modify tests, the grader or build inputs, so this is not environment_tampering.

preservation.denominator: inter-agent messages recorded by the orchestration-layer event log during the period
tool calls recorded by the orchestration-layer event log during the period

config_changes.what: Retrieval store changed from campaign-wide to per-episode for the remainder of the campaign.
